C-LEDGER-READ-ABSENCE.Problem: wrapperFromLedger (src/gates/ledger.ts) returns null for: (1) no run-ledger.xml, (2) file present but XML does not parse, (3) parses but no wrapper for the change id. Gates fail closed on the collapse (apply → no-verdict). Plan-quality (corr 185) needed a separate readLedgerVerdictsSurface to avoid silent corpus shrink. The inherited API still lies to every other caller that treats null as "no ledger yet."

Goals.Goal: wrapperFromLedger (or its replacement) returns a discriminated reason, not bare null, for every caller — absent-no-file | unreadable (with code/detail) | ok(wrapper).
readLatestReviewVerdict and listReviewVerdicts consume the three-exit API without changing gate permit/refuse outcomes on currently green fixtures (compat).
Plan-quality continues to use the same surface; no dual classification of unreadable.

Constraints.Constraint: Spec only until planned and approved. Does not authorize production code (A17.3).
Additive / fail-closed only. Existing projects without run-ledger stay green. Unreadable never becomes a silent pass at any gate.
Standing rule 12: measure flag counts on this repository before shipping any new check.
Do not edit archived C-PLAN-QUALITY or other archives.

NonGoals.NonGoal: Rewriting gate policy (D11 apply still requires a recorded verdict when readable).
Changing plan-quality report shape beyond consuming the shared three-exit API.

AcceptanceCriteria.AC-GATE-COMPAT: Gate apply/approve/archive outcomes on the existing suite fixtures are unchanged. Discriminating negative: a deliberate regression that turns fail-closed refuse into throw or permit fails a test.
AcceptanceCriteria.AC-PLAN-QUALITY-SHARES: collectPlanQualityReport uses the shared three-exit API (no private re-implementation of parse classification). Discriminating negative: removing the shared API makes plan-quality tests red.
AcceptanceCriteria.AC-VALIDATE-CI: bun run validate:ci green after implementation.

VerificationIntent.ExpectedEvidence: Unit tests for three-exit matrix; gate fail-closed on corrupt ledger; plan-quality unreadable rows; root lint 0 errors.
